C-DEALER-GT7-UI.Summary: Recreate GT7 Used and Legend dealer composition, responsive vehicle detail surfaces and meaningful companion actions using real local artwork/specifications.

Goals.Goal: Used: pale grey inventory, compact photo-left cards, official PP/drivetrain/aspiration, price and accurate stock badges.
Legendary: dark Hagerty collection, manufacturer logos, prominent model year, vehicle silhouettes, thin blue separators and stock/price display.
Card tap opens in-app details: Used light modal with large image, facts, specification grid and actions; Legendary dark showroom composition with specifications.
Join existing official catalogue by canonical ID, remove fabricated mileage, sort-as-PP and decorative arbitrary stars.
Provide useful persistent local wishlist actions and list; retain price history as an explicit separate action and official localized car history as Learn More.

Constraints.Constraint: Retain the shared dark navigation bar, window-navigation safe areas, source refresh/error states and local card assets.
Use Provider/ChangeNotifier and existing DI/routing; never change live inventory/pricing or infer unknown specifications.
Unknown mileage, body colour and ownership remain unknown; account collection is shown only if verified.
Use static existing artwork; do not claim a real 3D vehicle/warehouse viewer.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No PSN purchase actions, game account writes, complete app redesign, new gallery downloads, general refresh scheduler, commit or push.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Used/Legend clearly match their official reference compositions and preserve independent styles.
Real card taps open appropriate in-app details; close, Escape/back, focus and scroll restoration work without opening a browser.
PP/specifications come from exact official ID joins with consistent localized units; missing values never become fake mileage or ratings.
Wishlist toggles persist across restart and are visible in the shared wishlist page, with no implied PSN sync.
Russian/English, loading/partial error/offline states and 390/820/1280 widths pass tests and native Mac/iPhone verification.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: FVM widget/repository tests, analyzer and GRACE validation; native Mac/iPhone card/details/wishlist actions.
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Official references, reviewed interactive prototype, real local images, responsive screenshots and persistent wishlist regression.
